data.one_liner: A dismissible tile widget with animated customizable background and overlays on swipe.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DismissibleTile widget that can be swiped horizontally to trigger actions. It supports custom backgrounds, colors, overlays, transition builders, and dismiss confirmations.
use_when: You need a custom swipe-to-dismiss tile with animated background and overlays.
You want a horizontal-only dismissible list item with richer feedback than standard Flutter Dismissible.
avoid_when: You require vertical or multi-directional swipe dismissals.
You are looking for a complex list layout manager rather than an individual tile widget.
strengths: Customizable backgrounds, colors, and overlays for left-to-right and right-to-left swipes.
Supports dismiss confirmation, custom painters, and GlobalKey triggers.
weaknesses: Not documented for non-standard vertical swipe requirements.
data.minimal_example:
DismissibleTile(
    key: UniqueKey(),
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
    ltrBackground: const ColoredBox(color: Colors.yellowAccent),
    rtlBackground: const ColoredBox(color: Colors.greenAccent),
    child: Text('Swipe me'),
)
